test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the pair that is matched correctly (the institute to the city it is based in).

options.text: Central Arid Zone Research Institute - Jodhapur

solution:
The correct answer is __**Central Arid Zone Research Institute - Jodhapur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Central Arid Zone Research Institute - Jodhpur** is correctly matched.
 
• The **Central Arid Zone Research Institute (CAZRI)** is located in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, and focuses on research related to arid zones.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Central Leather Research Institute** is located in Chennai, not Salem.
 
• The **Central Potato Research Institute** is located in Shimla, not Dehradun.
 
• The **Central Drug Research Institute** is located in Lucknow, not Kanpur.
